config.title: Implementation Guide
config.description: Best practices for using notifications in your application

items.title: When to Use Notifications
items.content: Use success notifications for completed actions, error notifications for failures, warning notifications for potential issues, and info notifications for helpful tips or system updates.

items.title: Positioning & Duration
items.content: Toast notifications should appear in the top-right corner and auto-dismiss after 3-5 seconds. Banner notifications should appear at the top of the page and remain until dismissed by the user.

items.title: Accessibility Considerations
items.content: Ensure notifications are announced to screen readers, provide sufficient color contrast, and allow keyboard navigation for dismissing notifications.

items.title: Message Guidelines
items.content: Keep messages concise and actionable. Use clear titles and provide specific details in the message body. Avoid technical jargon and use friendly, human language.

items.title: How do I assign a task to multiple users?
items.content: Use the assignee field to select multiple team members from the dropdown. You can search by name or email address.

items.title: What happens after I create a task?
items.content: Once created, the task will appear in the tasks list and assigned users will receive a notification. You can edit or update the task status at any time.

items.title: Can I set recurring tasks?
items.content: Currently, recurring tasks are not supported. You'll need to create individual tasks for recurring activities.
